title: JSON exception when receving historical values from 600SeriesAndroidUploder
symptom: When the Medtronic 640G pump is back in range, historical values are not appearing in xDrip; only the current value appears. The log shows 'Got JSON exception org.json.JSONException: No value for direction'. This started after upgrading xDrip on the collecting device.
cause: Changes made on 4/7 in NSEmulatorReceiver.java added a slope parameter read from the direction parameter in JSON, which does not comply with 600SeriesAndroidUploader.
fix: The Sept 29th nightly resolves the problem; after installing the latest version, no exception occurs and history is uploaded.
evidence_quote: Further code review show - changes were done on 4/7 at file at file: app/src/main/java/com/eveningoutpost/dexdrip/NSEmulatorReceiver.java in function: bgReadingInsertFromData slope parameter was added, reading it from direction parameter in JSON I believe this addition does not comply with 600SeriesAndroidUploader
